Or should he do it without getting rid of that haram money? 2223 views Q. Origin of Men 3236 views Q. Tabligh Jamah 14932 views Q. Is there any sign or is there any way to know that Allah is accepting our prayers or Allah is pleased with our action? How can we increase our rank in terms of Iman to Allah? 1973 views Q. I am a college student at Srinagar Kashmir.being a muslim majority region many Islamic organizations are working here according to their ideologies & the conditions prevailing here. Amid such situation it is natural to have conflicts between different ideologies. But the problem arises when different schools of thought start rejecting each other and go to such an extent that they call eachother KAFIR , and other ideologies as BATIL. Still they may not feel any problem for themselves ,but it does become a problem for a common man when he tries return towards the Din of Allah, or when he becomes serious about Islam and wishes to work in the way of Allah . because it is a must to join an organization to work in a coordinated and fruitfull manner . but at this moment one has to decide which organization is on truth (Islam) . I?m in a similar dilemma as which way to choose to work in an organizational setup. Probably I was fortunate to meet a pious man who reminded me of our real aim in life and helped me to motivate myself to lead an Islamic way of life . he himself belongs to jamait-e-Islami. when looking onto the good points every organization has a sizeable list on the other hand if we try to point out the bad points there also we get many. and these are used by people for criticism . the various org here are jamait-e- islami , dadul uloom Deoband, Jamait ?e- ahl-e-hahith, Tableegi jamaat , Barailvi, Tehreek-e- hurriyat and many others . the good and bad points in each of themand as such one gets confused , and con not easily find out the whole of it by self study .. In this regard I request you to help me in searching out the pure Islam Your advice is very crucial to me because it is about the most important decision of my life and on it may rest the Judgment on the day of Judgment. Also plz pray for my guidance and sucess. Wa salaam 3204 views Q. I am 21 years, computer expert. i am very strong(kattar)follower of ulema-deoband i am very much influenced by them..but where i live here is large sect of brelvis who follows ahmad rida khan bidati...i know all the brelvis are bidati. all ulemas of brelvis use dirty languages of our respected ulema's they call em to be kafirs.. one of my friend is also brelvi he tells me not to follow deobandis they are kafirs, i ignore him every time, he gives me proofs of kitaabs writen by ulema e deoband,like our respected ulema, Maulana Qasim Nanotwi, Rashid Ahmad Gangohi.. Last Time i Met Him Was When i was going to perform jummah prayer..he was telling me not to go for prayer behind deobandis, come here, with me in our masjis, you will not have your salah behind them, i ignored him , then he uttered me same questions before he did... Now I Answered Him, From Al-Muhannad, I also gave him to listen the Bayans by our Great Ulemas, Zia-Rehman, & Maulana Makki On Milad-jaloos Aur bidaat, he was shocked, from then he never uttered me any questions related to deobandis, instead of that he respected me. should i believe that he if, he knows the reality. is it permissible for us to show the right path to barelvis like this... am i doing right job for islam... my aim is to save the ummah from bidat.. Is this the start for me... should i take one foot forward to do this job. 3142 views
answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 14907 Country: India Title: Assalam Waleikum. I'm a non-muslim by birth but a true muslim in belief. From my childhood days I'm witnessing parents' quarrel. Now I'm 26 yrs old and can well understand the reasons for that. I've discovered that from early days my father has been getting involved in multiple illegal relationships (sexual relation as well) sometimes with married women, divorsee, and presently with an unmarried girl younger than me. A few months back I accidentally found them both in a room in 'uncomfortable position' but I didn't protest openly. My father also remains in contact with that girl via cell phone almost everytime which is very irritating. These are not unknown to my mother. My parents divorsed and re-married again about 7 years ago. Both of my parents stay in separate places (also because of jobs) but have no actual contact (only for show). In such a situation, I'm helpless and worried of my mother's mental condition. I cannot understand what to do in such a situation as per Islamic way of life. Whether to protest strongly or to leave everything on Allah. Please guide me. N.B.- Because am a non-muslim, I cannot understand the Islamic terms. Pls give the English meanings as well. Thank you. Assalam Waleikum. Answer ID: 14907 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1503/1229=D/1430) First, you should contact any local aalim . And for understating Islam well, you should get and study the book ?Islam kya Hai? (by Maulana Manzoor Nomani) which is available in Hindi and English beside Urdu. You can express it verbally if it touches your heart; otherwise a person becomes Muslim by believing in the unity of Allah, prophethood of Hadhrat Muhammad and qiyamah and pronouncing the kalimah . After Islam, one is asked to follow other Islamic rulings such as salah, fasting etc and he is required to refrain from sins like infidelity, polytheism, wine, adultery, lying etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
